data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Geron, meaning 'venerable' or 'ancient'. Jerrine is a feminine variation, meaning 'little Geron'. In Christian tradition, this name symbolizes respect, wisdom, and faith. The name Jerrine carries the meaning “Jerry's little one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jerrine usually hope their child will grow to embody jerry's little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
